$comment: The coverage gaps of en frozen by scripts/units/coverage.js --freeze. This list may only SHRINK: a gap that is closed is taken off it (the gate fails until it is), and no new gap may be added to make a build pass. 2026-11-24: the eight Kindergarten social studies gaps were added ONCE as the Kindergarten social studies plan was first measured (decision 7): 5 unit checks and the 3 checks of the year, for the same reason (the card engine cannot read the social studies pages: record pages, drawings and matches of drawn pictures; an observation check or a card form closes them). The plan fills its 28 weeks: its 55 sessions share the half week where one unit ends and the next begins (scripts/units/assemble.js). 2026-11-25: the eight Grade 1 social studies gaps were added ONCE as the Grade 1 social studies plan was first measured (decision 7): 5 unit checks and the 3 checks of the year, for the same reason (record pages, drawings, matches of drawn pictures and an interview the card engine cannot read). The plan fills its 28 weeks the same way (56 sessions; "Read the map key" takes three). 2026-11-25: the eight Grade 2 social studies gaps were added ONCE as the Grade 2 social studies plan was first measured (decision 7): 5 unit checks and the 3 checks of the year, for the same reason (record pages, drawings, matches of drawn pictures and a teacher-led class market the card engine cannot read). The plan fills its 28 weeks the same way (the class market takes three sessions).
